# Mankunku · Jazz Practice

> A browser-based jazz ear training and lick-practice app. The user plays
> a phrase on their instrument, the app listens through the microphone,
> and pitch and rhythm are scored in real time.

Mankunku is named after the South African tenor saxophonist Winston "Mankunku"
Ngozi (1943–2009), whose 1968 album *Yakhal' Inkomo* ("Cry of the Bull") gives
the app its tagline. The project is open-source and runs entirely in the
browser as a SvelteKit PWA.

## What the app does

- **Ear training** — Call-and-response: the app plays a generated phrase in
  the day's key, the user echoes it back on their instrument. Pitch is
  detected at 60 fps with [Pitchy](https://github.com/ianprime0509/pitchy);
  rhythm is segmented from a custom AudioWorklet onset detector. Dynamic
  Time Warping aligns the user's notes to the expected sequence and absorbs
  human/detection latency.
- **Lick practice** — Drill curated jazz licks through all twelve keys
  over a backing-track rhythm section (bass, comping, drums, generated
  with smplr). Tempo adapts as the user masters keys.
- **Step entry** — A keyboard-driven UI for adding personal licks, with
  instrument-aware transposition (Bb / Eb / concert).

## Key concepts

- **Concert pitch is canonical.** All MIDI numbers and lick data are stored
  in concert pitch internally; transposition to written pitch happens only
  at display time.
- **Fraction-based rhythm.** Note durations are `[numerator, denominator]`
  tuples (e.g. `[1, 12]` = triplet eighth), converted to seconds only when
  scheduling audio.
- **Local-first.** All writes go to localStorage / IndexedDB first;
  Supabase cloud sync runs in the background. The app works fully offline.
- **Adaptive difficulty.** Levels 1–100 across 10 content tiers; per-key
  proficiency drives selection.

## Routes worth crawling

- [/](https://mankunkujazz.com/) — Home, two doors into Ear Training and Lick Practice.
- [/ear-training](https://mankunkujazz.com/ear-training) — Call-and-response practice.
- [/lick-practice](https://mankunkujazz.com/lick-practice) — Multi-key lick drills.
- [/library](https://mankunkujazz.com/library) — Curated lick browser.
- [/scales](https://mankunkujazz.com/scales) — Scale reference.
- [/docs](https://mankunkujazz.com/docs) — Full developer and user documentation.

The full documentation is at [/docs](https://mankunkujazz.com/docs). Notable

## Tech

SvelteKit 2 · Svelte 5 (runes) · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS 4 · Tone.js ·
Pitchy · Supabase · Node adapter · PWA.
